title: Pandi Nattu Thangam
desc: A village chief and his father, who control the village activities besides smuggling sandalwood, create problems for a forest officer, Thangapandian, and a fellow villager, Radha.

title: Jai
desc: Jai, a young boy, witnesses the murder of his parents at the hands of their greedy manager. When he grows up, he sets out with his caretaker to avenge the wrongs done to his family.

title: Karpura Mullai
desc: Maya finds her long-lost mother, who is a popular singer. Her mother refuses to reveal her father's identity and instead decides to publicly declare Maya as her daughter.

title: Sundara Kandam
desc: Priya, a young student, falls in love with her teacher, a man who shows no interest in her. Complications arise when the professor gets married, and she continues to stir trouble in his life.

title: Uthama Rasa
desc: Meenu, a bubbly girl, is in love with Chinnaiya, the village leader. Things change when Marudhu, who is the son of Chinnaiya's rival, Parama Thevar, falls for Meenu.
